references.text: Psalm 15 describes who may dwell on God's holy mountain, which can be seen as a parallel to being near the kingdom of God, as Jesus mentions.
The Sermon on the Mount, especially the Beatitudes, speaks about qualities and actions that bring people near the kingdom of God, similar to Jesus' comment about being near the kingdom of God.
A similar discussion about the greatest commandment and eternal life, pointing to closeness to the kingdom of God through understanding and obeying God's commands.
Jesus' conversation with Nicodemus about being born again to see the kingdom of God, relating to the idea of being near the kingdom of God through spiritual renewal.
